speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the sudden onset of vertigo. To narrow this down, are you experiencing any hearing loss, tinnitus, or a sensation of fullness in your ear on the affected side?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

Given the brief duration of only 3 minutes and the sudden onset while lying down, this strongly suggests BPPV. Are your symptoms triggered specifically by changes in head position, such as rolling over in bed or looking up?
